mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the chromosome sets was most worthwhile: the picture distinguishes that event from the later division of the cytoplasm.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial material fittings felt repetitive; their results gave little detail about how the cell grew.

surprise.text: The replication inset clarified that DNA doubles while sister chromatids remain joined, before they are separated.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though fitting proteins as a single cytoplasm-growth ingredient simplified a connection the result did not explain further.

continue.text: Yes, cautiously: the distinction between chromosome separation and cell division was useful, and the descendants suggest further branches to explore, though the early fittings were repetitive.
